summary: Add the MCP connector pkg/automation/connectors/mcp (Streamable HTTP over https on the official Go SDK, bearer or OAuth 2.1 with discovery, PKCE S256, Dynamic Client Registration and refresh under the row lock, SSRF guard on every hop) and its mcp_tool node, whose tool schema is pinned in the graph version on save with a warning when the server changes it; registered by the automations module by default (WithoutMCP opts out). graph: * segments in Templates/Values/Expressions paths, NodeSpec.ReadOnlyParam and OutputSchemas, ExprTypes, GraphError.Fix. catalog.PreparingNode lets a node check and fill its params on save; engine.Authoring.Validate returns warnings and Version.Warnings carries them. connectors: Store gains CredentialLocker and Sealer; ConnectionAuthorizer, StoreBinder, ErrClientRequired, IdentityServer and x-internal credential fields; a call whose connection needs a new sign-in fails as unauthorized. Editor: a validation issue with a fix offers it (update a pinned schema), warnings badge their card and come from a passed save (canvas chunk budget 52 KB); integrations: per-connection OAuth sign-in. Adds automations.mcp_tools RPC and mcptest, a fake MCP server.
